remarks: This inviting home offers more than meets the eye, with a surprisingly spacious interior and numerous updates completed by the current owners in recent years. Nearly every space has been refreshed, creating a welcoming atmosphere with hardwood floors that add warmth, charm, and character. Major mechanical updates include a new furnace just 5 months old and a hot water tank less than a year old, offering added peace of mind. The roof is approximately 10-12 years old; some windows have been replaced and the home features solid mechanics. The functional layout offers plenty of room to spread out, for those who are looking for an investment you can easily convert this to a 4 bedroom as it is a short walk to UB main campus. Enjoy the outdoors without a ton of upkeep with this spacious lawn. With thoughtful improvements, important updates already completed, and plenty of opportunity to make it your own, this home is a wonderful opportunity for its next owner or investor. Showings begin on Monday, October 19th at 9:00am.
